title: Dr.G expands U.S. presence with TikTok Shop launch
summary: Korean skincare brand Dr.G has officially launched on TikTok Shop in the United States, strengthening its retail presence in the market as it accelerates its international expansion under L'Oréal ownership. The launch follows L'Oréal's acquisition of Dr.G in 2024 and comes as the French beauty giant continues to invest in the global K-beauty category.
